# torch is intentionally NOT listed here -- install it first from the CPU-only
# index (see README "Setup"), otherwise a plain `pip install torch` pulls a
# multi-GB CUDA build you don't need for this MLP-sized policy.
pysc2
# tensorboard requires protobuf>=6.31.1, but pysc2's bundled s2clientprotocol
# wheel was generated with an old protoc that breaks ("Descriptors cannot be
# created directly") under that protobuf version. Both are satisfiable at
# once by pinning protobuf to what tensorboard wants and forcing the
# pure-Python protobuf backend for pysc2's stale generated files -- see the
# PROTOCOL_BUFFERS_PYTHON_IMPLEMENTATION env var set at the top of
# src/sc2rl/env/sc2_env_wrapper.py (the fix has to live in code, not just
# here, since it must run before anything imports google.protobuf).
protobuf>=6.31.1,<8.0.0
tensorboard
stable-baselines3
sb3-contrib
gymnasium
numpy
pyyaml
pytest
# Generative-AI command layer (src/sc2rl/command/, inference/interactive_play.py).
anthropic
flask
